title: Saint Agatha’s church
html_source:
The foundation stone of the church was laid on Sunday April 25th 1880 and the church was finally completed and blessed by the Archbishop of Dublin William Joseph Walsh on Sunday October 25th 1908.The church is a fine example of the Roman Renaissance style.
